claims.text: Coherent nanoprecipitate interfaces govern high-temperature plastic strain in tungsten-based refractory high-entropy alloys.
Coherent nanoprecipitate interfaces govern high-temperature fracture toughness in tungsten-based refractory high-entropy alloys.
Coherent nanoprecipitate interfaces facilitate direct or seamless dislocation transmission.
Coherent nanoprecipitate interfaces relieve local stress concentrations.
Dislocation transmission enabled by coherent interfaces promotes crack-tip blunting.
Relief of stress concentrations by coherent interfaces delays premature crack initiation.
Coherent interfaces enhance elevated-temperature plastic strain capacity.
Coherent interfaces enhance elevated-temperature fracture toughness.
At temperatures of at least 800 °C, specimens with coherent interfaces will be more ductile than specimens with incoherent interfaces.
At temperatures of at least 800 °C, specimens with coherent interfaces will exhibit delayed crack propagation relative to specimens with incoherent interfaces.
At temperatures of at least 800 °C, specimens with coherent interfaces will have greater fracture toughness than specimens with incoherent interfaces.
A comparison between coherent-interface and incoherent-interface specimens can isolate interface coherency as the causal variable.
The proposed mechanism applies to tungsten-based refractory high-entropy alloys under loading at or above 800 °C.
The proposed mechanism applies where irradiation effects are negligible.
The magnitude of the ductility and toughness improvement may depend on nanoprecipitate density and spacing.
Tungsten refractory high-entropy alloys with coherent nanoprecipitations are relevant to plasma-facing or fusion-reactor applications.

contradictions.description: The intervention proposes varying both nanoprecipitate coherency and spacing, whereas the boundary requires the overall microstructure aside from interface coherency to remain consistent. Varying spacing introduces an additional microstructural variable and prevents a clean isolation of coherency.
